notes.title: V1.3.25 UPDATE
notes.content:
Unity's networking solution (UNET) that we used in DEATHPIT was shutdown in July 2025, meaning that our online multiplayer is now sadly unavailable. Restoring it would require migrating the entire project over to a different networking solution, which is a large undertaking. 
We are a small two-man indie team that finished active development of DEATHPIT way back in 2018, and we did not plan to continue supporting it... However, we feel passionately about keeping the game alive so have decided to do what it takes to get the online multiplayer up and running again! In the meantime you can still play multiplayer online with your friends if you choose the Play LAN and use a VPN like Hamachi.

With this announcement comes the first update we’ve done to DEATHPIT in 7 years, in which we’ve added the ability to choose your main weapon in the game setup lobby instead of having to in-game (a gripe we’ve long wanted to remedy). Indeed this may be the beginning of a new wave of updates for DEATHPIT as we are quite excited to dust off the old code base and see what improvements we can easily make, so watch this space!

V1.3.25 CHANGELOG:
-	Online multiplayer lobby disabled while the project is converted to a new network solution.
-	Local Area Network multiplayer is supported (usable online with a VPN).
-	Players can now select a primary weapon when choosing characters in the lobby.

notes.title: DEATHPIT 3000 NOW SUPPORTS 4 PLAYER ONLINE CO-OP!
notes.content:
[u][b] V 1.3.13 PATCH NOTES [/b] [/u] 

[b]4 Player Online Co-op[/b][list]
[*] DEATHPIT 3000 now supports up to 4 players in online co-op
[*] Re-designed multiplayer lobby to reflect new player number selections
[/list]

[b]Other fixes and gameplay balances[/b][list]
[*] Linux gamepad issue fixed (Linux players must use "--mimic-xpad" with the xboxdrv for proper gamepad behaviour)
[*] Gamepad custom mapping enabled: hold "shift" or "alt" while launching the game to view configuration dialogue, or add "-show-screen-selector" in Set Launcher Options in Steam to always see it
[*] Aiming lazer toggle with V key
[*] Auto-follow other players after death
[*] Numerous performance optimizations and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: ONLINE CO-OP NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that online two-player co-op is now available for DEATHPIT 3000! In addition we have released a number of other improvements, including an update to full gamepad support for Steam Big Picture mode, and the ability to buy extra lives in single player.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831770/be5cf0d3b0300880c2c7b50ba5f39376c749359a.png[/img]

[u][b] V 1.3.0 PATCH NOTES [/b] [/u] 

[b] Online Co-op[/b][list]
 [*]New game mode supporting two players online
 [*]New lobby menu enabling you to host games for your friends and others to join
 [*] Deathpit Discord channel link added so you can meet and game with others in the DP3K community
[/list]

[b] Single Player Respawning[/b][list]
 [*]Buy extra clones in single-player with your spare spacebux, to allow for unplanned deaths!
 [*]Auto-switching to single player mode if your team-mate quits
[/list]

[b] Full Controller Support[/b][list]
 [*]Full controller support is now in place, enabling Steam Big Picture mode
 [*]Menus now navigable with both gamepad and mouse at the same time
[/list]

[b] Other additions[/b][list]
 [*]Improvements to the settings menus, including in-game resolution changing
 [*] New player animations
 [*] Improvements and tweaks to weapons and equipment
 [*]Improvements and balancing of the boss
 [*]Stun and freeze effects rebalanced
 [*]Network optimization
 [*]Numerous bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: GAMEPAD SUPPORT LAUNCHED!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831770/75a8dc27224b3cb607160afdbb444412f50a1c12.png[/img]

We are pleased to announce that gamepad support for Xbox controllers is now officially live, as well as a host of other improvements and fixes. So if you haven’t yet experienced the bloody viscera of the arena, now is the perfect time to jump in with both sticks blazing!


[u][b] V 1.2.0 PATCH NOTES [/b] [/u] 

[b] Full support for Xbox controllers added[/b][list]
 [*]Adjustable rotation speed for right stick
 [*]Gamepad cursor tracks player's aim direction
 [*]New system for teleporting with gamepad
 [*]Hint system updated to include gamepads
 [*]Menu navigation and selection for gamepad
[/list]

[b] Updated scoring system[/b] [list]
 [*]Live score displayed in game
 [*]Killing enemies with crates adds to score
 [*]Enemy score values displayed on scoresheet
[/list]

[b] Other additions[/b] [list]
 [*]New round selection menu
 [*]Pausing in single player
 [*]Screen damage blood effect
 [*]Added new ‘hardcore’ mode achievements (press ‘U’ for hardcore mode)
 [*]Weapon cycling with arrow keys added
 [*]‘Z Mode’ added for custom controls for players with cerebral palsy (type ‘zenko’ in main menu to activate)
 [*]Numerous bug fixes and optimisations
[/list]

notes.title: Xbox gamepad support coming soon!
notes.content: Since the release of DEATHPIT 3000, a number of users have requested gamepad support. We cyberlambs agree that this would be a great new feature and so we have decided to go ahead and include Xbox gamepad support. We expect to have it ready for Windows very soon!

notes.title: Improved scoring system on the way!
notes.content: Now that Deathpit is live, we are working on our first round of updates. We are in the process of improving the in-game scoring system by adding live scoring, so that you can see what points you and your friends are earning as you kill enemies and pick up spacebux (instead of having to wait until the end of a round to see). The aim is to add a fun edge of competitiveness while maintaining the co-op spirit of the game.[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30831770/c600708aca2b5408a6353fd8f45a893bfe234ea4.png[/img]
